scope: Ablate the changes committed at the start of this task, preserving the preceding simplifications and semantic fixes unless evidence supports removal.

source.hash_method: SHA256 of sorted rg --files paths (*.rs, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain.toml), each path + NUL + contents + NUL.
source.result: Simplifications remain uncommitted after the requested initial checkpoint.

method.negative_trials: Five compiled negative controls, each restored. Four use targeted regression tests; saved confirmation substitution is evaluated on the complete model. The model trial includes both positive simplifications; its comparison is the final combined model, not a factorial experiment. Patches are embedded for reproduction.
method.positive_trials: Two cumulative deletions, each passing all 422 hir-ty tests serially, followed by whole-workspace, upstream corpus, complete model and incremental checks.
method.initial_parallel_trial: The first hir-ty run used default test parallelism and had 6 failures, including unrelated direct solver tests reporting Unknown or BudgetExhausted. No semantic conclusion is drawn from it; unchanged code passed all 422 tests with --test-threads=1. Final gates also use serial tests.
method.limits: Passing finite tests is evidence, not a proof of equivalence for all programs. Formal solver limits and diagnostic policy are unchanged.

review_inventory.previous_ablation_simplifications: Preserved the semantic API removals, consolidated declaration diagnostics, and IDE integration simplifications already audited in 2026-10-24-ablation.json.
review_inventory.parser_and_type_lowering: Preserved constructor-pattern lowering, conditional aliases, Nat binder rules and finite-set parsing; exact upstream regression tests remain in the full gate.
review_inventory.dependent_inference_and_solver: Five negative controls cover existential joins, supported assumptions, confirmation substitutions, symbolic witness factors and polynomial cancellation. Two duplicate inference paths were removed.
review_inventory.diagnostic_and_oracle_infrastructure: Preserved full-call diagnostic ranges, active dependency checks, regenerated oracle, and task-pool deadline polling; whole-workspace and corpus gates cover them.
review_inventory.tests_and_baselines: Preserved existing regression coverage and immutable historical reports.
